evidence:
Sequencing: tests/test.sh:218-235 (identical to template) runs suite gates then suite scored with rewardkit --max-concurrent-agent 1 against ONE running app and ONE DB; no reseed between dimensions. Expected order gates/constraints, gates/render, scored/functional, scored/polish, scored/visual (alphabetical serial per historical runner observation, not re-measured for harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7), so I checked tolerance in both directions.
Pristine-seed dependencies exist only in Functional: Z (prompt.md:25) Lena Fischer 1 unread, seeded Platform Engineer order Applied Greta/Ade/Marco, Screen Priya/Samuel, Noor's note; hro_restart (judge.toml:416) re-checks those. Earlier dimensions do not disturb them: render prompt.md:9 'Do not create, move or send anything, and do not open any conversation'; constraints prompt.md:9 creates only its own new job/candidate and 'Do not move, reject or message anything'. Functional's own gate (prompt.md:11) also only creates a new job. Seed confirms Lena/notes/reads exist (seed_data.json reads[], notes[0] 'Strong systems answers; weaker on incident follow-up.').
If Polish/Visual ran before Functional they still would not break it: polish prompt.md:16 'Never use Lena Fischer's conversation', prompt.md:14 'Use your own new job and cards', note drafts only on 'your cards'; visual prompt.md:14 is read-only ('Do not move cards or send messages'). Polish adds Noor messages, but every Functional thread row is relative: app_context.md:29-31 '120 messages at the start... Other reviews may have added jobs, cards and messages; never rely on a starting count'; hro_thread_latest = most recent 30; hro_thread_earlier grades remaining count against observed; U reads counts before/after. Functional prompt.md:15 'Earlier reviews may have added jobs, cards and messages. Use your own new jobs ... never rely on starting counts'; T fallback 'counts read relative to their values before you act'; T 'if that address is already on J2, open a new job J3'.
Later dimensions after Functional's heavy mutations: polish uses its own job, relative Noor thread, and prompt.md:14 'If a message or note box already holds text from an earlier review, record it and clear it before typing your own' (handles server-persisted drafts left by Functional hro_drafts/Polish). Visual accepts any job with several stages ('a seeded job is fine') and makes only read-only craft judgements, so mutated Noor thread/boards are fine. Within Functional, later protocols are state-relative: A scopes Activity to J1/J2 and 'every successful board action ... before A'; D compares post-restart to values recorded just before restart; nothing in S-V touches the Platform Engineer job ('Move nothing on that job').
Adversarial trials: (1) broken app that reseeds on every start would show duplicated seed in D - correctly caught by hro_restart only. (2) conforming app persisting drafts server-side per user: Functional's hro_msg_compose/hro_drafts operate on a brand-new Tomas J2 conversation, and Polish clears inherited box text, so no false failure. (3) conforming app where Polish's leftover Rafael draft sits in Tomas's seeded Data Analyst thread only matters if Polish ran before Functional AND Functional fell back to that thread; under the observed alphabetical order it cannot occur.
Residual note (not a row-37 defect, template-controlled): Functional's restart_app (D, last) uses the frozen test.sh helper; if a submission fails to come back after restart, the app stays down for Polish and Visual, cascading one persistence defect into 0.4 of shaped weight. test.sh and restart_mcp.py are template files the task must not edit; recorded for the owner, not as a fail.
